questionText:

以下哪個組合正確辨認物質 X、Y 和 Z？
The rates of entry of three substances X, Y and Z into cultured human epithelial cells were investigated. Chemical M binds to all proteins in the cell membrane and makes them non-functional. The results are shown below.

Which of the following combinations correctly identifies substances X, Y and Z?

options.A:

(1) 在鏈 1 的互補鏈中，C 佔 30%。
(2) 在整個 DNA 分子中，A 佔 26%。
(3) 在整個 DNA 分子中，G 和 C 合共佔 50%。

Which of the following deductions are correct?

(2) In the whole DNA molecule, A makes up 26%.

某動物的基因型為 AaBb，兩對基因位於不同對的同源染色體上。假設沒有發生互換，這動物產生 AB、Ab、aB 和 ab 四種配子，比例相等。

以下哪個組合正確顯示令四種配子比例相等的過程 (X)，以及等位基因 A 與 a 分離的時期 (Y)？
An animal has the genotype AaBb. The two pairs of genes are on different pairs of homologous chromosomes. Assuming no crossing over, the animal produces four types of gametes, AB, Ab, aB and ab, in equal proportions.

Which of the following combinations correctly shows the process that gives the four types of gametes in equal proportions (X), and the stage at which alleles A and a separate (Y)?

options.A:
X：第二次減數細胞分裂時染色單體分離；Y：第二次減數細胞分裂後期
X: separation of chromatids in the second meiotic cell division; Y: anaphase of the second meiotic cell division
options.B:
X：第一次減數細胞分裂中期，各對同源染色體在赤道上隨機排列；Y：第一次減數細胞分裂後期
X: random arrangement of each pair of homologous chromosomes at the equator at metaphase of the first meiotic cell division; Y: anaphase of the first meiotic cell division
options.C:
X：受精時配子隨機結合；Y：第一次減數細胞分裂後期
X: random fusion of gametes at fertilisation; Y: anaphase of the first meiotic cell division
options.D:
X：第一次減數細胞分裂中期，各對同源染色體在赤道上隨機排列；Y：第二次減數細胞分裂後期
X: random arrangement of each pair of homologous chromosomes at the equator at metaphase of the first meiotic cell division; Y: anaphase of the second meiotic cell division

根據以上資料，可以得出以下哪項推論？
The table below shows the number of differences in the amino acid sequence of protein E among four species K, L, M and N.

With reference to the information above, which of the following can be deduced?

options.A:
N 是四個物種中最古老、最原始的物種。
N is the oldest and most primitive of the four species.
options.B:
M 由 K 進化而來。
M evolved from K.
options.C:

questionText:
某火山島上的熔岩冷卻後，地衣首先在岩石上生長。研究人員收集已死的地衣碎片，全部消毒後分成兩份，混入已消毒的岩石碎屑：一份再加入土壤細菌，另一份不加。兩份都撒上苔蘚孢子。數月後，只有加入土壤細菌的一組有苔蘚生長。

在演替初期，分解者幫助苔蘚生長，主要是因為它們
After lava cooled on a volcanic island, lichens were the first organisms to grow on the rocks. Dead lichen fragments were collected, sterilised and mixed with sterilised rock particles in two portions. Soil bacteria were added to one portion but not the other. Moss spores were added to both. After a few months, mosses grew only in the portion with soil bacteria.

In the early stage of succession, decomposers help the growth of mosses mainly because they

options.A:
把已死的地衣分解成二氧化碳，供苔蘚進行光合作用。
break down dead lichens into carbon dioxide for photosynthesis of mosses.
options.B:
把大氣中的氮轉化為硝酸鹽，供苔蘚吸收。
convert nitrogen in the atmosphere into nitrates for absorption by mosses.
options.C:
分解已死的有機物，釋出礦物質，並與岩石碎屑形成土壤。
break down dead organic matter to release minerals, forming soil with the rock particles.
options.D:
移除已死的地衣，騰出空間讓苔蘚生長。
remove dead lichens to make space for mosses to grow.

questionText:

(1) 三個物種佔有不同的生態位。

(3) 這些螞蟻的食物只在牠們活躍的時段才出現。

(1) The three species occupy different ecological niches.
(2) Interspecific competition between species Q and R is likely to be weaker than that between P and Q.
(3) The food of these ants is available only during the periods when they are active.

questionText:
指示：參考以下實驗，解答第 11 和 12 題。學生以下圖的裝置 P 和 Q 研究蒼蠅幼蟲的呼吸作用。兩個裝置置於 25°C 的水浴中，裝置 Q 的玻璃珠令兩個裝置內的空氣體積相同。

假設蒼蠅幼蟲只以葡萄糖作呼吸受質，並只進行需氧呼吸。10 分鐘後，裝置 P 和 Q 內的顏色液會有什麼變化？
Directions: Questions 11 and 12 refer to an experiment in which a student used set-ups P and Q below to study respiration of blowfly larvae. Both set-ups were placed in a water bath at 25°C. The glass beads in set-up Q made the volume of air in both set-ups the same.

Assume that the blowfly larvae use only glucose as the respiratory substrate and carry out aerobic respiration only. What will happen to the coloured liquid in set-ups P and Q after 10 minutes?

options.A:
P：向試管的方向移動；Q：沒有變化
P: moves towards the tube; Q: stays still
options.B:
P：向試管的方向移動；Q：向試管的方向移動
P: moves towards the tube; Q: moves towards the tube
options.C:
P：遠離試管的方向移動；Q：沒有變化
P: moves away from the tube; Q: stays still
options.D:
P：沒有變化；Q：遠離試管的方向移動
P: stays still; Q: moves away from the tube

questionText:
指示：參考以下實驗，解答第 11 和 12 題。學生以下圖的裝置 P 和 Q 研究蒼蠅幼蟲的呼吸作用。兩個裝置置於 25°C 的水浴中，裝置 Q 的玻璃珠令兩個裝置內的空氣體積相同。

實際進行實驗時，學生發現裝置 Q 的顏色液在 10 分鐘內緩慢向試管的方向移動了 3 mm。已知以不同受質進行需氧呼吸時，每消耗 1 體積氧所釋出的二氧化碳體積如下：碳水化合物 1.0；脂肪 0.7。

以下哪項最能解釋這結果？
Directions: Questions 11 and 12 refer to an experiment in which a student used set-ups P and Q below to study respiration of blowfly larvae. Both set-ups were placed in a water bath at 25°C. The glass beads in set-up Q made the volume of air in both set-ups the same.

When the experiment was actually carried out, the student found that the coloured liquid in set-up Q moved slowly towards the tube by 3 mm in 10 minutes. In aerobic respiration, the volume of carbon dioxide released per volume of oxygen used is 1.0 for carbohydrate and 0.7 for fat.

Which of the following best explains this result?

options.A:
蒼蠅幼蟲同時進行缺氧呼吸。
The blowfly larvae also carried out anaerobic respiration.
options.B:
實驗期間水浴的溫度上升。
The temperature of the water bath rose during the experiment.
options.C:
玻璃珠吸收了蒼蠅幼蟲釋出的二氧化碳。
The glass beads absorbed the carbon dioxide released by the larvae.
options.D:
蒼蠅幼蟲同時以脂肪作呼吸受質，吸收的氧多於釋出的二氧化碳。
The blowfly larvae also used fat as a respiratory substrate, taking in more oxygen than the carbon dioxide released.

哪個標示的位置有最高的二氧化碳濃度？
The diagram below shows a group of alveoli in a human lung, and one enlarged alveolus with the blood capillary around it.

Which labelled part has the highest concentration of carbon dioxide?

肺氣腫患者的氣囊壁受破壞，相鄰的氣囊合併；肺組織的彈性亦下降。下圖顯示正常肺組織和肺氣腫患者的肺組織。

以下哪些是肺氣腫患者可能出現的情況？
(1) 肺內進行氣體交換的總表面面積減少。
(2) 氣囊內空氣與血液之間的擴散距離縮短。
(3) 每次呼氣後留在肺內的空氣較多，令氣囊與血液之間的氧濃度梯度變小。
In people with emphysema, the walls of the alveoli are damaged and neighbouring alveoli merge. The lung tissue also loses elasticity. The diagram below shows normal lung tissue and lung tissue with emphysema.

Which of the following are likely to occur in a person with emphysema?
(1) The total surface area for gas exchange in the lungs decreases.
(2) The diffusion distance between the air in the alveoli and the blood is shortened.
(3) More air remains in the lungs after each exhalation, so the oxygen concentration gradient between the alveoli and the blood becomes smaller.

questionText:
一名病人的二尖瓣（左心房與左心室之間的房室瓣）不能完全關閉。以下哪項最可能是這缺陷的後果？
The bicuspid valve (the atrioventricular valve between the left atrium and the left ventricle) of a patient cannot close completely. Which of the following is most likely to be a consequence of this defect?

options.A:
心室舒張時，血液不能由左心房流入左心室。
When the ventricles relax, blood cannot flow from the left atrium into the left ventricle.
options.B:
左心室收縮時，部分血液倒流入左心房，令泵入大動脈的血量減少。
When the left ventricle contracts, some blood flows back into the left atrium, so less blood is pumped into the aorta.
options.C:
左心室收縮時，血液經二尖瓣流入右心房。
When the left ventricle contracts, blood flows through the bicuspid valve into the right atrium.
options.D:
心室舒張時，血液由大動脈倒流入左心室。
When the ventricles relax, blood flows back from the aorta into the left ventricle.

(1) 在 0.03% 二氧化碳下，二氧化碳濃度是碳固定速率的限制因素。
(2) 在首 300 秒，J 和 K 的濃度保持穩定，表示兩者的生成速率等於消耗速率。

Directions: Questions 26 and 27 refer to an experiment in which spinach leaf discs were placed in a solution under constant light intensity, and the relative concentrations of two compounds J and K in the Calvin cycle were measured. Which of the following conclusions can be drawn from the results of this experiment?
(1) At 0.03% carbon dioxide, carbon dioxide concentration is a limiting factor of the rate of carbon fixation.

Directions: Questions 28 and 29 refer to the diagram below, which shows a section of a leaf of a plant growing in a dry and sunny area.

options.B:
上表面受較強陽光照射，溫度較高，W 減少水分從上表面蒸發流失。
The upper surface receives stronger sunlight and is at a higher temperature, and W reduces water loss by evaporation from the upper surface.
options.C:

W consists of dead cells which support the leaf.
options.D:
W 可儲存水分，在乾旱時供葉片使用。
W stores water for use by the leaf during drought.

豌豆成熟時，P 會變乾、扭曲並裂開，把種子彈出。與由動物進食果實而散播的種子比較，這種散播方法有什麼不利之處？
Directions: Questions 32 to 34 refer to the diagram below, which shows an opened pea pod and a section of one of its seeds. The pea plant bearing this pod has the genotype Aa, and its flower received pollen from a plant of genotype aa.
